My read. B looks the most like a shipped product and is the one I would put on the App Store or a pitch slide. A survives smaller sizes better, so the favicon and the in-app mascot would use A's front-on geometry whichever you choose. C is a light-mode companion, not a competitor. All three are hand-built vector, so they scale to any size with no upscaling.
